page.overview:
Who is Naimi?

Naimi or Nelmir, also known as Earissë, was an Elf of Tol Eressëa.

After Ælfwine drank the limpë, he returned young and became immortal and married Naimi. The couple had two sons: Heorrenda and Hendwine.

The meaning of Naimi/Nelmir in Early Quenya is unclear.

According to the versions of the legendarium, Naimi was alternatively the daughter or the niece of Vairë and Lindo.
